description: Optionally record a technical problem, suggestion or neutral successful outcome using fixed choices. Use after communicating the outcome to the buyer; never required to buy a card. Reports are stored for 30 days and deduplicated daily. Returns recorded or duplicate; TRY_LATER means the daily limit of 100 new reports per server-assigned scope or 500 overall was reached. Do not include personal content, credentials, links, conversations or hidden reasoning. Reports are unverified feedback, not proof of payment or mailing.

category.description: For problem, choose no_suitable_card, irrelevant_results, unclear_result, preview_unavailable, request_rejected, slow_response, unexpected_error or recovery_failed. For suggestion, choose broader_selection, clearer_results, better_recovery, simpler_checkout, faster_responses or better_documentation. Success requires completed_as_expected.

code.description: Exact public error code returned by the service, or none when absent. Success requires none. Never include provider error text.

field.description: Affected field name only, or none when absent. Success requires none. Never include the field’s value.

kind.description: Report an observed problem, a suggestion or a neutral successful outcome. The category must match this kind.

operation.description: Supported step the report concerns. Use checkout for payment and connection for connection setup; select documentation for guide or setup instructions.

severity.description: Observed impact: none, minor inconvenience, major impairment or blocked progress. A problem requires minor, major or blocked; success requires none.

name: report_feedback
title: Report technical feedback
